Angel Company details Anduril is a developer of defense technology focused on delivering consumer hardware and national-security software, leveraging off-the-shelf components with custom engineering to bring products to market faster, cheaper and more effectively. The company was founded by Brian Schimpf, Matthew Grimm, Palmer Luckey, Trae Stephens, and Joseph Chen in 2017 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
